llm.summary: The skill's files and runtime instructions match its stated purpose (building and maintaining a local Karpathy-style LLM wiki); included scripts only fetch PDFs from arXiv and write local wiki/raw files, so nothing appears to be asking for unrelated secrets or network exfiltration.

dimensions.detail: Name/description describe a persistent LLM-maintained research wiki; SKILL.md and the bundled scripts implement ingest/query/lint workflows and a helper to download recent arXiv papers — all directly relevant to the stated purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md directs the agent to read and write files inside a defined repo layout (raw/, wiki/, assets/) which is expected for this use. This grants the skill broad file-write authority within the project directory (creating/overwriting markdown and PDFs). That's appropriate for a wiki skill but users should be aware the agent will author many files autonomously.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec; this is instruction-first with two small helper scripts. No remote archives or third-party package installs are pulled during install, so footprint is minimal.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: No environment variables, credentials, or special config paths are requested. The scripts make outbound HTTPS calls only to export.arxiv.org and arxiv.org to fetch metadata and PDFs — consistent with the skill's purpose.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always:false and no modifications to other skills or system-wide configs. The skill expects to write and append files in its own repo (wiki/log.md, wiki pages, raw/papers), which is proportionate to a wiki-maintenance skill.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears coherent for building a local Karpathy-style wiki. Before installing or running it: (1) confirm you want the agent to create and modify files under the repository (raw/, wiki/, assets/); (2) inspect and run the bundled scripts only in a sandboxed project directory — they download PDFs from arXiv and write them to raw/papers; (3) note the shell script contains duplicated/embedded Python text (a likely accidental paste) — it's not evidence of malicious behavior but you may want to clean/verify the scripts before use; (4) avoid placing secrets inside the repo (raw/ or wiki/) because the agent will read and write files there; and (5) if you run this on a shared machine, ensure network access to arXiv is acceptable and consider running in an isolated environment.
